text: fantastisk app. Virkelig gjort alle mine lister nemmere
author: Line mark Andersen
developer_reply: Tusind tak for din feedback! Det glæder os virkelig at høre, at Tiimo har gjort dine lister nemmere at håndtere. Vi sætter stor pris på din støtte og håber, at Tiimo fortsætter med at gøre din hverdag lidt lettere.

text: As a person struggleling with ADHD for many years, this has been the single most helpful tool that I use on a daily basis 💪
author: Jacqueline Pepke
developer_reply: Thank you so much for sharing this 💜 Knowing Tiimo has become such an important part of your daily life truly means a lot to us. We’re so happy the app is helping support you in a way that feels meaningful and useful every day.
